user.title: Connect your AppLights Star Spinner
user.description: Keep AppLights closed. Choose the light or enter its Bluetooth address and existing password. Setup verifies the password without changing the light. Supports Star SpinnerC / BTM2-5 only.

password.title: Connect {name}
password.description: Keep the AppLights app closed. Enter the light's existing password. Its password and output will not be changed during setup.

error.invalid_address: Enter a Bluetooth address in AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF format.
error.invalid_password: The password must contain 1 to 8 UTF-8 bytes.
error.invalid_auth: The light rejected this password. Enter the existing AppLights password.
error.not_supported: This light does not identify as the supported Star SpinnerC / BTM2-5.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect. Close AppLights, check power and Bluetooth range, then try again.

abort.not_supported: Only Star SpinnerC / BTM2-5 has been validated.
